  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

description:

Join to apply for the Staff Software Engineer role at Shape Digital

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Staff Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and evolving software systems that are robust, scalable, and aligned with the company’s strategic objectives.
As a Staff Software Engineer , the goal is to identify the most appropriate technical solution for each problem. Sometimes the best approach may be a well-architected existing library or service, while other times it may require designing new systems from the ground up.
A high level of technical rigor is expected, with well-documented designs, reproducible results, and reliable systems. It is also expected that you stay updated with software engineering best practices, architectural patterns, and emerging technologies, while effectively incorporating domain knowledge into the solutions you build.
Solutions are expected to be developed end-to-end, from design and prototyping to production deployment and long-term maintenance, always meeting high engineering standards. You will also know when to build versus buy, ensuring accelerated value delivery.
The Staff Software Engineer is, above all, a pragmatic problem-solver, technical leader, and a core contributor to the success of all products developed by Shape Digital.
Responsibilities:

  • Explore and identify opportunities to improve and evolve the company’s software architecture and platform foundations.
  • Write and guide others to write high-quality, scalable, secure, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Lead the design and development of complex software systems, ensuring they meet performance, security, and reliability requirements.
  • Manage the technical backlog, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term architectural evolution.
  • Mentor senior engineers and influence across multiple teams, driving adoption of engineering excellence and best practices.
  • Ensure software systems follow rigorous quality standards, including testing, monitoring, and documentation.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, frameworks, and architectural paradigms, applying them when they create business value.
  • Contribute to technical strategy, architectural decision-making, and long-term technology vision.
Requirements:
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C#, Go, or similar).
  • Proven experience in designing and maintaining large-scale, distributed, or mission-critical systems.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, and design patterns.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and cloud-native architectures.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.
Differentials:
  • Knowledge of industrial or enterprise-scale systems.
  • Experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code, observability stacks, and security best practices.
  • Contributions to open-source projects, technical publications, or patents.
Benefits:
  • PPR (Profit Sharing): Possibility of extra compensation based on the company’s results, according to your performance.
  • Health and Dental Plan: To ensure your care and well-being!
  • Flexible Benefit: Receive an amount that can be used according to your needs, including food, transportation, education, culture, and health. You decide how to use it!
  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.
  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.
  • Gympass: To keep your health in check and take care of your body.
  • Snacks in the Office: Because everyone loves a snack at work!
  • Inclusive Environment: We value diversity and always strive to create a space where everyone can be authentic, respected, and feel part of something bigger.
  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.
  • Childcare Assistance: To support you with the care of your young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: We offer support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well-being: We create an environment that values mental health, work-life balance, and encourages connection with culture.

description:

O profissional será responsável por garantir a estabilidade, performance e segurança de ambientes SAP em operação contínua, participando de atividades de monitoramento, troubleshooting, upgrades, incidentes e mudanças críticas. Diferenciais

  • Certificações adicionais: SAP ALM (Support), Cloud Infrastructure, SAP Web Dispatcher, HANA Runtime, Cloud Connector.

  • Vivência em Serviços Gerenciados com foco em melhoria contínua.

title: Senior Software Engineer Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares :

Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Interaction Platform

A tribo de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas mobile e os padrões de experiência globais através da adoção KMP viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior SWE

Como Sênior SWE Mobile esperamos que possa ter grande influência técnica no time, com o papel de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, será "hands on" que precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone. Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

Além de :

  • Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
  • Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;
  • Auxiliar a equipe na resolução de problemas complexos e na descoberta de soluções;
  • Fornecer sugestões e críticas construtivas para disseminar conhecimento técnico;
  • Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto / plataforma;
  • Promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento e mentoria para o desenvolvimento da equipe, preocupar-se com o crescimento técnico;
  • Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa;
  • Fornecer visibilidade do trabalho;
  • Definir, coletar, analisar e acompanhar métricas de saúde de aplicações / produtos;
  • Participar de pair, revisões de código e refinamentos para discutir soluções técnicas, garantir qualidade e compartilhar conhecimentos;
  • Buscar continuamente oportunidades para melhorar nossa plataforma mobile, processos e experiência do nosso cliente dev;

O que esperamos de você

  • Ter interesse em trabalhar com adoção de novas tecnologias e aprender mais sobre KMP;
  • Fortes conhecimentos em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Fortes conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Habilidade para integrar APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI / CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e / ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares, comunicando-se de forma eficaz com demais pessoas do time, designers, desenvolvedores, gerentes de produto e outros stakeholders, com habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Capacidade de influenciar em definições de prioridades e estimar prazos juntamente ao time;
  • Experiência em ambiente com arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma concisa, franca e clara (também por escrito);

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Conhecimentos em KMP - Kotlin Multiplataforma
  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI / UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e / ou apps de larga escala;

Nossos benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta : contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e / ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio Creche
  • PLR
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição : Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People : Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica : Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura : Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback : Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo conosco!

#Li-Remote

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

description:

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is the world's first AI Super App designed to help anyone earn, learn, and grow in the AI era. We are building a global, fully remote team to shape the future of financial technology. About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and driven MLOps Engineer to design, automate, and optimize our machine learning infrastructure. In this role, you will play a crucial part in bridging the gap between data science and operations by streamlining our AI / ML workflows from experimentation to production.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, and developers to ensure our models are secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your work will directly impact thousands of users worldwide by enabling real-time, AI-powered financial insights and business solutions.

If you are passionate about deploying cutting-edge ML technologies and want to be part of a mission-driven fintech startup, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do

  • Automate ML pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD frameworks.

  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for efficiency and cost.
  • Ensure compliance and security protocols for sensitive financial data.
  • Provide support and maintenance to ensure the reliability of ML applications.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience as an MLOps Engineer or similar role (fintech or AI startup experience is a plus).
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); familiarity with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Experience with ML frameworks and pipeline orchestration (MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI / CD tools.
  • Strong understanding of ML algorithms and their real-world applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote, cross-timezone team environment.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Why You'll Love Working at Bizmoni

  • Be part of a mission-driven company building the future of AI-powered FinTech.
  • Fully remote role with a global, diverse team.
  • Equity-based compensation with the potential for future full-time opportunities.
  • Culture of innovation, collaboration, and ownership.

  • Are you open to equity-based compensation?
  • Are you able to dedicate 16 hours weekly to our project?

If your answers are YES, then we are happy to meet you!

Recruitment Process

  • Interview with Data Science Department Manager & TA Partner.
  • Offer (based on final positive feedback).

Please submit your English CV.

Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview. Thank you.

Bizmoni is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

title: Principal Engineer - Sensor, Linux (Remote)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”, which is an application installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network and correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a Principal Software Engineer role in the engineering team that delivers the sensor (lightweight agent) on Linux. This team owns the core platform for the Linux sensor, which has two variants: one using eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter), and another using Linux kernel modules. Features cross-cut most core Linux kernel subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are often built in a way that they have shared components across Windows and Mac sensors. The team operates at a fast pace and ships frequently.

What You'll Do:

  • Provide technical guidance to management in making product and roadmap decisions affecting the Linux sensor.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews for key platform features within the Linux sensor.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional remote teams in various locations across multiple OSes (Linux, Windows, Mac).
  • Mentor senior engineers to help grow and scale the team.
  • Act as a role model for the team to foster a culture of software quality and resilience.
  • Engage with the upstream Linux kernel community on bug fixes, backports, or other kernel issues that may affect the Linux sensor.

What You’ll Need:

  • In-depth knowledge of low-level Linux internals.
  • Strong experience with C and/or C++.
  • Experience designing and implementing complex, performant, and highly concurrent systems.
  • The ability to be assertive yet collaborative in high stakes situations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with executives, product management, customers, and other engineers.
  • Ability to navigate technical risk to make pragmatic tradeoffs between product quality and deadline pressures.
  • Ability to operate efficiently in a remote, highly distributed work environment.
  • We expect that most successful candidates would have 10+ years of experience working on Linux systems programming close to or in the kernel, as well as experience as a team or project lead.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with eBPF.
  • Experience working with Linux kernel modules.
  • Knowledge in the security space.
  • Experience working with open source communities, especially the Linux kernel community.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Remote-friendly and flexible work culture
  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment.

The base salary range for this position for all U.S. candidates is $195,000 - $290,000 per year, with eligibility for bonuses, equity grants and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, 401k and paid time off.

Pursuit of Excellence: We are extremely competitive, ambitious, and driven to be exceptional – as individuals, teams, and as an organization. There is no standard high enough and we will never settle. We aspire to attract, retain, and empower the very best people.
Startup Mentality: Outliant began with 5 startup founders, and startup culture is deep in our DNA. It’s a critical advantage that allows us to move faster, be more resourceful, and empower our team at all levels. We are in the early chapters of our journey.
World-Class Remote Collaboration: Outliant is (and always has been) a 100% remote company – we have no offices and our teams are distributed around the world. Given the freedom and autonomy this provides, we require that our people excel in this remote structure.

About the role:
As a Senior Director of Engineering, you will assume a critical leadership role, responsible for guiding multiple engineering teams and shaping the technical strategy for key areas of our business. You will bridge the gap between high-level vision and tactical execution, empowering your managers and their teams to deliver exceptional results.
With your blend of deep technical expertise, strategic foresight, and proven leadership, you will drive complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives and foster a culture of innovation and excellence. This is a chance to make a significant impact on our products, scale our engineering practices, and mentor the next generation of technical leaders.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Management and Development : Lead, manage, and scale multiple high-performing engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical excellence across your entire department.
  • People Management : Oversee the hiring, performance reviews, and career development for engineers and engineering managers, ensuring team members have clear growth paths and the mentorship needed to succeed.
  • Performance Management : Own the performance management process for your domain, setting ambitious goals, providing constructive feedback, and driving a continuous improvement mindset among managers and individual contributors.

  • Project and Process Oversight : Ensure that cross-team dependencies and strategic roadblocks are identified and resolved with urgency, maintaining momentum on large-scale initiatives.
  • Alignment with Company Goals : Balance the needs of your teams with the company's broader strategic objectives, aligning technical roadmaps with business goals and identifying opportunities to scale processes and improve efficiency.
  • Metrics Analysis : Define, analyze, and report on key performance metrics for your department, leveraging data to inform strategic decisions and communicate progress to executive leadership.

  • Strategic Development : Co-develop and execute a comprehensive technical strategy that aligns with the product vision and overall business goals, ensuring the long-term health and scalability of our systems.
  • Innovative Solutions Identification : Identify, champion, and lead the implementation of innovative technical solutions to tackle complex architectural and business challenges, driving a forward-thinking engineering culture.

  • Workload and Resource Management : Manage and prioritize the technical workload across multiple teams, ensuring efficient resource allocation and effective development practices that meet strategic deadlines.
  • Budget and Resource Allocation : Oversee the budget, headcount planning, and resource allocation for your department, ensuring optimal use of resources to achieve project goals and financial targets.

  • Problem-Solving and Communication : Anticipate and proactively address potential architectural and organizational roadblocks, empowering your managers and teams to solve problems independently while providing strategic guidance.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, translating complex technical strategies and trade-offs into clear business impact.

  • Continuous Improvement : Stay current on the latest technologies and industry trends, evaluating and implementing solutions to enhance development processes, team performance, and overall organizational effectiveness.

Requirements:

  • Possesses a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.
  • Has 8+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity. Proven experience managing other engineering managers is required.
  • Mastery of a broad range of technical skills and deep expertise in system architecture, design patterns, and building scalable, distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with agile development methodologies and DevOps practices, with a track record of scaling these practices across multiple teams.
  • Strong familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop other managers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Demonstrated success in managing large-scale, complex, cross-functional projects from inception to completion.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative solutions for ambiguous and complex challenges.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business goals into a clear technical strategy and roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Significant experience in budget management, resource planning, and cost optimization for multiple teams or a department.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and drive change and process improvements within a growing organization.

title: Senior Software Engineer Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares :

Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Interaction Platform

A tribo de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas mobile e os padrões de experiência globais através da adoção KMP viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior SWE

Como Sênior SWE Mobile esperamos que possa ter grande influência técnica no time, com o papel de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, será "hands on" que precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone. Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

Além de :

  • Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
  • Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;
  • Auxiliar a equipe na resolução de problemas complexos e na descoberta de soluções;
  • Fornecer sugestões e críticas construtivas para disseminar conhecimento técnico;
  • Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto / plataforma;
  • Promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento e mentoria para o desenvolvimento da equipe, preocupar-se com o crescimento técnico;
  • Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa;
  • Fornecer visibilidade do trabalho;
  • Definir, coletar, analisar e acompanhar métricas de saúde de aplicações / produtos;
  • Participar de pair, revisões de código e refinamentos para discutir soluções técnicas, garantir qualidade e compartilhar conhecimentos;
  • Buscar continuamente oportunidades para melhorar nossa plataforma mobile, processos e experiência do nosso cliente dev;

O que esperamos de você

  • Ter interesse em trabalhar com adoção de novas tecnologias e aprender mais sobre KMP;
  • Fortes conhecimentos em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Fortes conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Habilidade para integrar APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI / CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e / ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares, comunicando-se de forma eficaz com demais pessoas do time, designers, desenvolvedores, gerentes de produto e outros stakeholders, com habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Capacidade de influenciar em definições de prioridades e estimar prazos juntamente ao time;
  • Experiência em ambiente com arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma concisa, franca e clara (também por escrito);

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Conhecimentos em KMP - Kotlin Multiplataforma
  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI / UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e / ou apps de larga escala;

Nossos benefícios

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Entrevistas com o time de People : Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback : Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Job description

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Gerente De Projetos De Ti
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo / briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.

Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação / publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e / ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).

Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 às 19h00

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação via cartão Swile;
  • Assistência médica SulAmérica 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Assistência odontológica- opcional;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Gympass;
  • Auxílio Creche para filhos de até 5 anos;
  • Assistência Pet;
  • Auxílio Home Office.

Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?

Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  • Proatividade, comprometimento e autonomia.
  • Coragem, ousadia e espírito empreendedor.
  • Agilidade, organização e foco em solução.
  • Curiosidade por novas ferramentas e aprendizado contínuo.

Jornada de trabalho :

  • Horário comercial, com flexibilidade.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais.
  • Disponibilidade para eventual trabalho presencial.
  • Eventuais demandas aos finais de semana.

Remuneração : R$4.000 nos 3 primeiros meses, R$5.000 após o 3 primeiros meses.

Estrutura e crescimento :

O(a) profissional será o primeiro contratado da empresa, reportando-se diretamente aos sócios. Existe perspectiva de crescimento e possibilidade de liderar uma equipe no médio prazo.

Local de Trabalho : Remoto

Objetivo da contratação :

Contratar um(a) profissional multidisciplinar, com experiência em gestão de projetos e visão executiva de startup, para estruturar e conduzir a operação dos dois principais produtos da empresa : IVF Experience (fertilização in vitro com turismo) e CGP (consultoria de governança digital para saúde).

Principais responsabilidades :

  • Organizar e acompanhar a execução de projetos da IVF Experience e da CGP.
  • Apoiar sócios na gestão administrativa, financeira e operacional.
  • Estruturar processos internos, contratos, fornecedores, logística e atendimento a clientes.
  • Implementar e administrar ferramentas de CRM (RD Station) e gestão de projetos.
  • Acompanhar orçamentos, fluxo de caixa, DRE e relatórios financeiros, em interface com a contabilidade.
  • Construir propostas comerciais da CGD e apoiar negociações com parceiros da IVF (clínicas, fornecedores e turismo).
  • Liderar contratações futuras e estruturar a equipe, no médio prazo.
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas com os sócios, contribuindo para decisões do Board.

Indicadores de sucesso no 1º ano :

  • Estruturação de processos básicos e gestão organizada.
  • Cumprimento de metas de vendas e / ou receita (dependendo da definição final).
  • Clientes satisfeitos (NPS > 8).
  • Implementação de rotina de gestão à vista e uso efetivo do CRM.
  • Contratação e liderança da primeira equipe da empresa.

Requisitos técnicos :

  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em gestão de projetos, operações ou funções executivas.
  • Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras (fluxo de caixa, orçamentos, relatórios).

Desejável :

  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado ou intermediário.

Perfil comportamental :

  • Inteligência emocional, autocontrole e resiliência.
  • Proatividade, comprometimento e autonomia.
  • Coragem, ousadia e espírito empreendedor.
  • Agilidade, organização e foco em solução.
  • Curiosidade por novas ferramentas e aprendizado contínuo.

Jornada de trabalho :

  • Horário comercial, com flexibilidade.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais.
  • Disponibilidade para eventual trabalho presencial.
  • Eventuais demandas aos finais de semana.

Remuneração : R$4.000 nos 3 primeiros meses, R$5.000 após o 3 primeiros meses.

Estrutura e crescimento :

O(a) profissional será o primeiro contratado da empresa, reportando-se diretamente aos sócios. Existe perspectiva de crescimento e possibilidade de liderar uma equipe no médio prazo.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Sr Analyst Trade Marketing
description:
Posição: Analista Sr. de Trade Marketing Canal

Local de trabalho: Around São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and/or Santa Catarina

Regime: Remote

Você ama chocolate? Agora imagina trabalhar com essa gostosura!

Reportando-se a Gerente de Trade Marketing, o Analista de Trade Marketing Canal Sr será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de trade marketing para a praça do estado de São Paulo, com uma perspectiva entre canais, visando aumentar a visibilidade da Hershey no ponto de venda e impulsionar o sell-out.

REQUISITOS

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Atuação anterior na área de Trade Marketing Canal, em indústrias de FMCG;
  • Experiência na região / mercado de São Paulo e conhecimento sólido nos principais canais de distribuição (indireto e direto);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power Point;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de sell-out como Neogrid, Scanntech, Kantar e/ou Nielsen;
  • Habilidade analítica, capacidade de interpretar dados de mercado e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Perfil proativo com boa comunicação e relacionamento entre áreas / clientes;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em São Paulo, São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and/or Santa Catarina
  • Formato remoto e com disponibilidade para viajar 20%
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediários serão considerados diferenciais.

DETALHES DO DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO

  • Desenvolvimento e execução de planos de trade marketing para todos os canais da praça de São Paulo, exceto Key Accounts;
  • Análise de dados de mercado e de vendas para identificação de oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Colaboração com equipes de vendas e marketing para alinhar estratégias e objetivos;
  • Gestão do orçamento de trade marketing e garantir a eficiência dos investimentos;
  • Monitoramento e avaliação da performance das campanhas de trade marketing;
  • Relacionamento com parceiros de canal e negociação de ações promocionais;
  • Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações de resultados para a alta gestão.

Na Hershey, temos uma herança única, marcas icônicas, funcionários talentosos e uma cultura empresarial baseada no princípio de sempre criar bons momentos em nossas comunidades ao redor do mundo. Temos um futuro brilhante pela frente, mas precisamos de um grupo diversificado de pessoas dedicadas e talentosas para ajudar a cumprir nossa missão.

SOBRE A THE HERSHEY COMPANY

A Hershey Brasil iniciou sua operação em 1998 e é uma das principais marcas da categoria no país. A empresa está no Ranking das 150 Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil pelo Great Place to Work e é considerada a 7ª Melhor Indústria para se trabalhar no Brasil.

A Hershey Company é um empregador de oportunidades iguais. A política da Hershey Company é ampliar as oportunidades para candidatos e funcionários qualificados em igualdade de condições, independentemente da raça, cor, sexo, idade, origem nacional, religião, estado de cidadania, estado civil, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, status transgênero, deficiência física ou mental, estado veterano protegido, informações genéticas, gravidez ou quaisquer outras categorias protegidas pelo federal aplicável, leis estaduais ou locais.

title: Senior Product Manager, Order Management
description:
Senior Product Manager, Order Management

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role covers the entire post-purchase experience in the e-commerce journey — a critical, customer-facing product that connects multiple smaller features and has impact across several other products.

As Senior Product Manager for Order Management , you will be responsible for ensuring the scalability, stability, and continuous evolution of our Order Management System (OMS). You will operate in a dynamic environment where product boundaries are less rigid than in larger organizations, giving you visibility and ownership across multiple domains such as Order Allocation, Fulfillment, and Order Management.

Your work will be at the heart of VTEX’s commerce platform — orchestrating integrations, evolving APIs, and ensuring a seamless experience for merchants and customers globally.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead rollouts of existing products and launch new features that impact global merchants and customers.
  • Manage and prioritize multiple streams of work, balancing module evolution with stakeholder expectations.
  • Drive the evolution of the OMS module, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop and maintain critical APIs and other integrations impacting related products.
  • Collaborate across domains, including Fulfillment, Order Allocation, and Order Management, to ensure cohesive product evolution.
  • Balance short-term deliverables with a long-term strategic vision for the OMS roadmap.
  • Engage, align, and manage stakeholders across technical and business areas, navigating high-pressure and complex prioritization environments.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong background in Product Management with exposure to Order Management Systems (OMS), Fulfillment, or Order Lifecycle processes.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple stakeholders and interdependent roadmaps.
  • Strategic and analytical thinker with a hands-on, ownership-driven mindset.
  • Experienced in environments with high integration complexity (APIs, multiple products, legacy systems).
  • Degree in Engineering or related fields.
  • Fluent English for cross-functional collaboration in a global context.

ABOUT VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

Benefits

  • Annual profit-sharing program and equity eligibility;
  • Health, dental, and life insurance with national coverage provided by VTEX;
  • Flexible meal allowance;
  • Extended parental leaves;
  • Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture;
  • Financial assistance to build your work-from-home setup;
  • Wellness program;
  • Free shipping on 1000+ VTEX stores

VTEX is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

description:
Senior Product Manager, Social Marketplaces & Live Shopping

ABOUT THE ROLE

VTEX is the backbone of connected commerce. This is why we believe in the power of shopping driven by network effect & influence. Our integrations with Google, Meta, and TikTok Ads , combined with our Live Shopping product, are at the core of this vision. We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Product Manager to lead the product strategy for Social Marketplaces & Live Shopping, shaping how commerce happens at the intersection of content, community, and conversion.

This role will be pivotal in defining global target markets, understanding customer needs, and unlocking opportunities for platform evolution that strengthen our value proposition. You’ll work cross-functionally with our core commerce technology teams and external partners, driving execution of the strategy and expanding the products worldwide.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • PM of two squads: one managing integrations with Google, Meta, and TikTok, and the other focused on the Live Shopping add-on.
  • Define and evolve product strategy, aligning roadmaps with business priorities and customer impact.
  • Identify and analyze global target markets and customer profiles, uncovering growth opportunities.
  • Negotiate and collaborate with both internal teams and external partners to ensure successful execution.
  • Shape adoption and retention strategies across regions, being directly involved in GTM strategy.
  • Drive cross-team alignment: ensure Social Marketplaces and Live Shopping scale efficiently by leveraging VTEX’s commerce core.
  • Increase transparency and engagement around the product roadmap with customers, through initiatives like roadmap artifacts, webinars with Tier 1 customers, and presentations to leadership.
  • Spot high ROI opportunities, leading research and analysis to validate and prioritize them.
  • Be an active voice in the Product Management chapter, helping raise the bar for product excellence at VTEX.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong background in product strategy and product management within retail, e-commerce, or tech environments.
  • Skilled at building alignment, negotiating, and managing relationships across multiple levels and teams.
  • Comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative analysis to drive business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to craft clear narratives and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Fluent in English and at least intermediate level of Spanish for daily collaboration.
  • Curious about consumer behavior, passionate about how integrations, social platforms, and network effects can drive GMV growth and reshape shopping experiences.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in 2000, VTEX has a history of growth and a global presence with more than 1,300 employees across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.
