title: Loan Partner II
description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 7,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Loan Partner II delivers exceptional customer service from contract to closing by guiding borrowers through each step of the loan process. This role oversees the end-to-end loan pipeline, including interest rate locks, to ensure timely and compliant closings. By providing consistent updates on key milestones, next steps, and action items, this role keeps borrowers and real estate partners well-informed. The Loan Partner II drives high customer satisfaction and fosters lasting client relationships through proactive communication and engagement.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality customer service throughout the loan process, from contract execution to closing.
  • Contact the borrower within 24 hours of file receipt to introduce the role, set expectations, outline next steps, and review the Uniform Residential Loan Application (Form 1003) for completeness and accuracy.
  • Send introductory emails to both the buyer’s and seller’s agents for new purchase contracts, copying the Loan Officer.
  • Create and distribute personalized introductory and appreciation videos to enhance client engagement.
  • Distribute, review, and explain (via phone call) the Closing Disclosures (CDs) to borrowers, addressing questions and correcting errors before sending the documents out for signature.
  • Notify Realtors and builders to coordinate closing, providing client support as needed.
  • Draft and distribute closing notifications to all parties, detailing the date, time, location, required documents, cash-to-close amounts, and remittance instructions.
  • Notify the Marketing team of the closing date, time, and location to ensure on-site closing gift delivery.
  • Maintain a minimum 95% five-star rating on post-closing client satisfaction surveys.
  • Manage a pipeline of loans to ensure smooth and on-time closings; participate in daily and weekly pipeline review meetings to track loan status and address processing bottlenecks.
  • Stay current on loan products and regulatory requirements to ensure accurate and compliant processing.
  • Review loan files to identify and notate any items needed from the borrower within 24 hours prior to submission.
  • Collaborate with the Operations Manager to troubleshoot and resolve processing challenges.
  • Communicate underwriting conditions to borrowers within 48 hours of receipt, providing both verbal explanations and written condition lists.
  • Perform a quality control review of final loan paperwork against established checklists and compliance standards.
  • Submit loans to Underwriting at least 15 days before the scheduled closing.
  • Deliver closing documents to Closing within 72 hours (3 business days) prior to the closing date.
  • Distribute weekly lender status updates (LSUs) to Realtors, Loan Officers, and Operations Managers.
  • Notify borrowers of key milestones such as appraisal completion, underwriting approval, and document delivery to the title company and provide weekly status updates through scheduled phone calls and follow-up emails, summarizing progress, soliciting feedback, and requesting referrals.
  • Conduct post-closing follow-up via phone call and email to congratulate, thank, and gather feedback from the borrower.
  • Generate at least one client referral per transaction through proactive relationship management and service excellence.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • State and Federal NMLS License, preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in conventional fixed-rate and ARM, HELOC, and construction mortgage loan processing or origination.
  • Experience with mortgage loan processing.
  • Experience with Encompass.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in DU, LP, Microsoft Office, and Windows.

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job.

Pay Range:

  • Hourly Rate: $24.04-$26.44
  • Eligible for monthly bonus incentive.
  • The posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Job description

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Overview

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client’s business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and broaden sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

description:
A GSK continua comprometida em alcançar ambições comerciais ousadas para o futuro. Até 2031, pretendemos entregar £ 40 bilhões em vendas anuais, alavancando nosso forte impulso de desempenho existente para aumentar significativamente nosso impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pacientes em todo o mundo. Nossa estratégia Ahead Together está centrada na intervenção precoce para prevenir e alterar o curso da doença, protegendo assim as pessoas e apoiando os sistemas de saúde.

Nosso portfólio diversificado consiste em vacinas, medicamentos especializados e medicamentos gerais. Por meio da inovação contínua e de um foco dedicado à excelência científica e técnica, nos esforçamos para desenvolver e lançar tratamentos novos e inovadores que atendam aos desafios críticos de saúde.

Essa posição poderá ser baseada em qualquer região do Brasil.

Como Payer Liaison na GSK, você atuará como uma ponte crítica entre a empresa e as diferentes partes interessadas na área de saúde (pagadores privados, gerentes de saúde, acesso kol), garantindo que os produtos da GSK sejam acessíveis aos pacientes e reembolsáveis. Esse papel possui envolvimento com as principais partes interessadas, ferramentas HEOR, negociação de contratos, novas formas de gestão e implementação de estratégias de acesso ao mercado nos principais clientes, visando otimizar o posicionamento de mercado e reembolso dos produtos da GSK.

Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas, marketing, assuntos regulatórios e assuntos médicos para alinhar as estratégias de acesso ao mercado com os objetivos gerais de negócios. Fornecer treinamento e suporte às equipes internas sobre tópicos relacionados ao pagador.
  • Realizar análises completas dos dados do pagador para informar a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Preparar e apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre o cenário do pagador, desempenho do contrato e métricas de acesso ao mercado.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com as principais organizações pagadoras, incluindo seguradoras, agências governamentais e gerentes de benefícios farmacêuticos. Servir como o principal ponto de contato para consultas e comunicações do pagador.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas para desenvolver e implementar estratégias de acesso ao mercado para produtos novos e existentes. Analisar tendências do mercado e as políticas de pagadores para identificar oportunidades e ameaças.
  • Liderar negociações com os pagadores para garantir a colocação do formulário e condições de reembolso favoráveis. Garantir a conformidade com todos os requisitos legais e regulamentares durante as negociações.

Qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Experiência em relações com pagadores, acesso ao mercado ou reembolso de assistência médica.
  • Conhecimento de análises farmacoeconômicas.
  • Histórico comprovado de negociações contratuais bem-sucedidas com pagadores.
  • Forte compreensão do cenário da saúde e da dinâmica do pagador.
  • Disponibilidade de Viagens.

Diferencial:

  • Inglês – Nível Avançado.

GSK é uma empresa biofarmacêutica global com o objetivo de unir ciência, tecnologia e talento para superar a doença juntos. Nossa cultura de ser ambicioso para os pacientes, responsável pelo impacto e fazer o que é certo é a base para como, juntos, entregamos para os pacientes, acionistas e nossas pessoas.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

Smart Age Solutions is a leading full-service digital marketing agency. We’re experts in growing online audiences into loyal customers by increasing your visibility online. With everything from SEO packaging to pay-per-click advertising, we are at the cutting edge of online marketing.

Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Engenheiro de Dados

Buscamos uma pessoa com um conhecimento em engenharia e análise de dados, principalmente voltada para soluções na Azure. Trabalhará com plataformas e aplicações disponíveis na Kantar e a principal responsabilidade é planejar e desenvolver soluções desde a arquitetura até a entrega (desde a arquitetura, passando pela ETL e finalizando na visualização dos dados no Power Bi), passando por todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software.

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos: Entender junto ao cliente quais as necessidades de negócio, propor soluções e documentar essas necessidades através de especificações funcionais;

  • Sustentação das aplicações em produção, visando garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade destes sistemas.

O que buscamos?

Qualificações fundamentais

  • Sólida experiência como analista ou engenheiro de dados;
  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio dos conceitos de programação (estruturas de dados, lógica de programação, algoritmos, orientação a objetos, etc);
  • Coleta e preparação dos dados (mapeamento de fontes, ETL e limpeza de dados usando Azure Databricks);
  • Análise de dados (exploração, identificação de padrões, criação de dashboards no Power BI);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de bancos de dados relacional e multidimensional;
  • Conhecimento em consultas a Data Warehouse Hive (HiveSQL);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem PySpark / Python;
  • Experiencia com PowerBI;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Devops (principalmente Repos e CI / CD);
  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e / ou KANBAN).

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e orquestração de pipelines de dados utilizando ADF (Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados não relacional;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e aplicações Azure.

  • Horário Flexível

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues

  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles

  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

title: Lead HR Generalist - Americas
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future.

The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant, and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

The role entails:

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy.

  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture, and engagement initiatives that drive a high-performing team.

  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region.

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.

  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness, and insights.
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders.
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines.
  • Experience mentoring and developing others.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track.
  • Experience in working in a remote-first organization.
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions.
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, open-minded, and enthusiastic.

  • Facilitation skills.

  • Maternity and paternity leave.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.

  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.

  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida / efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.

Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.

Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Graphic Designer + Marketing Assistant + Video Editor
description:
Graphic Designer & Marketing Assistant (Home Renovation / Roofing)

Company: 2URN Marketing — performance marketing for roofing & home renovation contractors

Website:

Location: Remote (USA) — Standard hours 9:00–5:00 PM CDT

Type: Full-time (open to contractor-to-hire)

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.
  • Edit content end-to-end: Cut UGC, before / after, job-site clips; add captions, hooks, overlays, CTAs; ship multiple variations.
  • Build offer / angle packs: Translate roofing value props (financing, storm damage, warranties, same-day inspection) into hooks, headlines, and visuals.
  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
